backlog.title: Traceability enforcer is blind to portal/ — CI gate cannot detect spec drift in portal app
backlog.detail: source_dirs = ['Source', 'E2E'] omits portal/. All FR-001..095 and FR-DUP-* portal-side requirements are never scanned. Running the enforcer reports 34 false-negative missing requirements.
backlog.recommendation: Add 'portal' to source_dirs at line 73. Tighten extraction regex from FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ to \bFR-[A-Z]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)+\b to eliminate false positives from seed data IDs.

backlog.title: Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md has zero implementation (FR-TMP-001..010)
backlog.detail: 10 functional requirements (risk classification, Playwright E2E generation, live E2E runner, auto-PR creation, AI PR review, auto-merge logic) with zero // Verifies: FR-TMP-* comments anywhere in the codebase. No Plans/ entry exists. Spec was authored but never scheduled.
backlog.recommendation: (a) Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md and schedule implementation via TheATeam, or (b) archive to Specifications/future/ if deferred. Do not leave an unimplemented spec in canonical Specifications/.

backlog.title: FR-dependency-api-types: blocked_by missing from UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput
backlog.detail: Both PATCH input types are missing blocked_by?: string[]. DependencyPicker.tsx compensates with as any casts at lines 291/293. TypeScript provides no type-checking on the blocked_by field in the PATCH flow.
backlog.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[]; to both UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput; remove as any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx:291,293.

backlog.title: FR-dependency-frontend-tests: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx missing
backlog.detail: FR-dependency-frontend-tests requires tests for both DependencySection and BlockedBadge components. Only DependencyPicker.test.tsx exists. Both components are in production use in BugDetail and FeatureRequestDetail.
backlog.recommendation: Create portal/Frontend/tests/DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx with // Verifies: FR-dependency-section and // Verifies: FR-dependency-blocked-badge comments.

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed: no seed.ts in portal/Backend/src/database/
backlog.detail: FR-dependency-seed requires an idempotent seed.ts inserting known dependency relationships on startup. Only connection.ts and schema.ts exist. Fresh install shows empty dependency UI; integration tests require manual data setup.
backlog.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with 4 described dependency relationships; call from server startup guarded by idempotency check.

backlog.title: Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts missing dependency_check_duration_seconds histogram
backlog.detail: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 metrics: dependency_operations_total, dispatch_gating_events_total, cycle_detection_events_total, and dependency_check_duration_seconds. Only the first three counters are defined. The histogram is absent from Source/. The metrics test only asserts on the three counters, so the gap is not caught by CI.
backlog.recommendation: Add Histogram for dependency_check_duration_seconds to Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts; add assertion in the metrics test.
